contea di ritrovamento: North East Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ DN VALEN[---] ; R/ [SECVRITAS REI PVBLICAE]

Copper alloy coin. Nummus of the House of Valentinian (364-378), Victory left, possibly Arles mint, Reece period 19. Obverse description: Bust draped diademed and cuirassed right. Obverse inscription: DN VALEN[---]. Reverse description: Victory advancing left with wreath and palm, OF III in field. Reverse inscription: [SECVRITAS REI PVBLICAE]. In exergue: possibly CON.
